text:
nina: FYI deployed inference-gateway v2026.03.22 to all regions ~now. kicking off post-deploy synths. tagging because apac3 prefills looked noisy in smoke earlier. watching.

deploy-bot: rollout complete for service=inference-gateway version=v2026.03.22 staged=100% :rocket:

ops-bot: alert (synthetic): apac3.kv-prefill.p99 breached at 6123341130, value=1200ms, threshold=400ms :warning:

cheng: digging in. /healthz responses are fine. the kv-prefill path is where synthetic hits cold prefixes; seeing a pattern of prefill-worker restarts and GC spikes in apac3 hosts. snippet from node logs: 
```
[2026-03-21T12:05:28Z] prefill-worker[pid=834] ERROR OOM: mem=3.9G limit=4G, restarting
[2026-03-21T12:05:29Z] prefill-worker[pid=834] INFO restart backoff=2s
[2026-03-21T12:05:29Z] inference-gateway[pid=1001] INFO prefill: started prefix X size=64KB
```

nina: do we know if this is code in v2026.03.22 or a config/regression in the prefill concurrency? apac3 has slightly smaller machines so it could be hitting memory threshold.

sre-oncall: quick options: 1) temporarily reduce prefill.concurrency per-region via dynamic config, 2) steer apac3 traffic back to v2026.03.21 if we suspect a code regression, 3) full rollback. preference is (1) to avoid a full rollback unless errors increase. opening playbook entry INF-981.

cheng: agree with 1, less disruptive. we can set runtime config 'prefill.concurrency' to 2 in apac3. that should reduce memory per-host and avoid restarts.

deploy-bot: applying dynamic config override: inference-gateway@apac3 prefill.concurrency=2 (applied at 6123341160) :gear:

cheng: re-ran the kv-prefill synthetic after ~30s. p99 dropped to ~220ms, p95 ~150ms. no further worker restarts in last 60s. looks like concurrency pressure was the main factor.

sre-oncall: keeping a 1h watch and will add apac3-prefill to the smoke dashboard. filing INF-981 with trace links and screenshots.

nina: good catch. i'll add a short note to the release notes /changelog: "apac3 observed kv-prefill tail latency spike post-deploy; temporary prefill.concurrency limit applied; follow-up fix planned."

ops-bot: incident mitigated candidate. will auto-close if no recurrence in 15m. :white_check_mark:

cheng: leaving thread open for 1h for verification. will follow up with post-mortem if we need a code fix. thanks everyone.
